<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl groups in the molecule. The carbon NMR spectrum will show signals for each distinct carbon environment. Methyl carbons typically appear in the 10‑30 ppm region. By retrieving the 13C NMR data for the sample and counting the peaks in that region, we can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
